summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results and providing a corporate update. The filing includes a press release detailing revenue of $1.5 million for the quarter and reaffirming full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $24-26 million. It discusses progress in the EscharEx Phase III VALUE trial and NexoBrid commercial updates. No specific deal terms, M&A, activist campaigns, or other special-situation events are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings update with operational milestones, not a special situation.
